title_sq: Tek ETC-ja, Shitet Ambient Biznesi I Pershtatshem Per Investim !!
description_sq: Tek Qendra Tregtare ETC "European Trade Center" (Galeria), ne zonen me te preferuar te Tiranes, prapa "Piramides" Shitet nje Ambient Biznesi, me nje siperfaqe 67 m2. Aktualisht funksionon si Zyre por mund te perdoret lehtesisht edhe per biznese te tjera . Ambienti aktualisht eshte i ndare ne dy pjese me mur gipsi dhe mund te behet shume lehte open space, ka investime cilesore si sistem aspirimi qendror, kondicioner po ashtu me sistem qendror, punime gipsi, ndricim LED, etj.
title_en: At ETC, a business environment suitable for investment is for sale!!
description_en: At the ETC "European Trade Center" (Gallery), in the most preferred area of ​​Tirana, behind the "Piramide", a business premises is for sale, with an area of ​​67 m2. It currently functions as an office but can easily be used for other businesses as well. The environment is currently divided into two parts by a plaster wall and can be easily made into an open space, there are quality investments such as a central aspiration system, air conditioning also with a central system, plaster work, LED lighting, etc.
